releases.body:
## First stable release

Generate and edit images from OpenCode, with local PNG outputs your agent can inspect and reuse.

[npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/oc-multi-imagegen) · [Publish workflow](https://github.com/imarshallwidjaja/oc-multi-imagegen/actions/runs/40431085325)

- **Codex by default:** use your OpenCode ChatGPT sign-in for text-to-image generation, reference-guided edits and transparent cut-outs.
- **OpenAI Images API:** use a separate image API key and native pixel sizes.
- **NanoGPT:** choose from curated generation/editing model pairs, with model-specific controls and local model guidance.
- **Both OpenCode hosts:** one package serves OpenCode 1 and OpenCode 2 and includes the image-work skill.
- **Illustrated documentation:** a real Codex walkthrough covers generation, a reference edit and a transparent character asset.

## Install

OpenCode 1:

```json
{
  "plugin": ["oc-multi-imagegen@1.0.0"]
}
```

OpenCode 2:

```json
{
  "plugins": ["oc-multi-imagegen@1.0.0"]
}
```

Restart the server that loads the plugin. See the [setup guide](https://github.com/imarshallwidjaja/oc-multi-imagegen/blob/v1.0.0/docs/getting-started.md) for authentication and backend configuration.

## Verification

The release passes the mocked unit suite, typecheck, formatting, build and packaging checks. It is published by GitHub Actions using npm Trusted Publishing, with provenance linking the package to its source workflow.

NanoGPT's curated model support has mocked coverage and has not been validated with live NanoGPT calls. [Backend coverage](https://github.com/imarshallwidjaja/oc-multi-imagegen/blob/v1.0.0/docs/backends.md#compatibility-and-recorded-coverage) records the tested host versions and live-run limits.
